top_signals.title: Germany’s Power Grid Could Be NATO’s Weakest Link
top_signals.summary: If Russia attacks a NATO member, Germany would have six months to move as many as 800,000 allied troops and 200,000 vehicles across the country toward the eastern flank. The ports, airports and railways required for that movement already carry military equipment through Europe and toward Ukraine. Germany says Russia attempted to bomb a Ukrainian cargo aircraft at Leipzig/Halle Airport, which houses NATO’s heavy-airlift program. Fires and incendiary devices subsequently reached European ammunition, drone and military-electronics companies,…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Modern Warfare Is Burning Through the Metals Needed for a High-Tech Future
top_signals.summary: I've been writing for more than a decade and a half about a broad category of metals often nowadays dubbed "strategic" because they are crucial to high-tech applications such as solar photovoltaic panels, wind turbines, electric vehicles, flat screens, semiconductors, batteries, optics, aerospace and a wide array of military applications including night vision, radar systems, communications satellites, radiation shielding, vehicle armor, submarine hulls, precision weaponry, and on and on. It is the military applications that interest me here because…
